title: What If Earth Spun on Its Side Like Uranus?

scenes.text: What if Earth rolled onto its side like Uranus? Some places would see no sunset for years.
Uranus is tilted about 98 degrees. Each pole gets 42 years of nonstop sunlight, then 42 years of darkness.
On Earth the same tilt would give each pole months of constant sun, and months of total night.
The equator would flip. It would get its coldest, darkest season while the poles roasted.
Summer poles would melt ice and winter poles would freeze solid, every single year.
Today's 23 and a half degree tilt is why we get gentle seasons. A tilt this big would end that.
